data.one_liner: A reactive animated progress bar widget supporting both vertical and horizontal directions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable progress bar widget that animates smoothly when values change. It supports linear bars, gradient colors, border radii, custom durations, curves, and separate shadows for the background and progress bar.
use_when: You need a reactive animated progress bar with custom duration and curves.
You need support for both horizontal and vertical progress layouts.
avoid_when: You need complex circular progress indicators or gauges.
You prefer using heavy general animation frameworks like Rive or Lottie.
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical orientations.
Customizable gradients, shadows, and border radii.
Reactive-style animation with configurable curves and durations.
weaknesses: Limited to linear progress bar shapes.
Not documented for non-standard custom shapes or complex multi-step wizards.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a comprehensive general-purpose animation library for widgets instead of a dedicated progress bar.

alternatives.name: smooth_page_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary goal is page or step navigation indicators rather than a general loading/progress bar.

data.minimal_example:
SimpleAnimationProgressBar(
    height: 30,
    width: 300,
    backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade800,
    foregroundColor: Colors.purple,
    ratio: 0.5,
    direction: Axis.horizontal,
    curve: Curves.fastLinearToSlowEaseIn,
    duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
)
